## Key terms

{{< glossary gaming-platform game-console gaming-pc cloud-gaming dev-kit certification graphics-settings system-requirements free-to-play premium-game porting cross-platform cross-play cross-save >}}

## 23.1 What is a gaming platform?

- A **gaming platform:** hardware + software + store + rules.
- **Consoles** (home and handheld), **gaming PCs**, **mobile devices**,
  **cloud gaming**.

![Four kinds of gaming platforms.](images/platforms.png){width=94%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
The store, its rules and its players are part of the platform too.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Your platforms"}
List the platforms you and your family play on: device, input, store.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 1 · Platforms"}
Choose the platform.

::: {.match extra="a printer|a router"}
a TV, a controller, the same hardware for all
:   a game console

old laptops to strong desktops
:   a gaming PC

touch, battery, short sessions
:   a mobile device

the game runs on a server and streams video
:   cloud gaming
:::
:::

## 23.2 Consoles and gaming PCs

- **Console:** fixed hardware; one target to tune and test; a **dev kit**
  and **certification**.
- **Gaming PC:** varied hardware; **graphics settings** and **system
  requirements**; open stores; much testing.

![Fixed or varied hardware.](images/hardware-variety.png){width=94%}

{{< sim file="sims/platform-profiles.html" poster="sims/platform-profiles.png" title="Platform Profiles: compare two platforms" height="760" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
A strong gaming PC can be stronger than a console; the console's strength
is that all players have the same hardware.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Compare two platforms"}
In **Platform Profiles**, compare the console and the gaming PC; write two
differences that matter for Byte Bay.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 2 · Console or PC"}
Use Platform Profiles. Choose the right answer.

::: {.match extra="a USB cable|a speed test"}
needed from the platform maker to make console games
:   a dev kit

the check of a console game before release
:   certification

low, medium and high for many PCs
:   graphics settings

minimum and recommended specs on the store page
:   system requirements
:::
:::

## 23.3 Mobile and cloud gaming

- **Mobile:** touch, fragmentation, battery and heat; mostly
  **free-to-play** (a **premium game** is paid once).
- **Cloud gaming:** the server runs the game; the device sends inputs and
  shows a video stream.
- Example values: 720p about 10 Mbps, 1080p about 20 Mbps; delay = ping +
  about 40 ms.

![Cloud gaming.](images/cloud-gaming.png){width=94%}

{{< sim file="sims/cloud-gaming-lab.html" poster="sims/cloud-gaming-lab.png" title="Cloud Gaming Lab: is the network good enough?" height="700" >}}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
Cloud gaming moves the work to the server; the network must be fast and
stable.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Test the network"}
In **Cloud Gaming Lab**, find the bandwidth for sharp 1080p and the highest
ping that is good for racing.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 3 · The stream"}
Use Cloud Gaming Lab. Choose the right answer (example values).

::: {.match extra="1 Mbps|500 ms"}
bandwidth for a sharp 1080p stream
:   about 20 Mbps

total delay with a ping of 60 ms
:   100 ms

the highest ping that is good for racing
:   40 ms

a 720p stream on an 8 Mbps line
:   blocky
:::
:::

## 23.4 Strengths, limits and cross-platform games

- **Cross-platform:** one code base, several platforms.
- **Porting:** adapt controls, menus, settings and store rules.
- **Cross-play:** play together. **Cross-save:** one progress.

![Strengths and limits.](images/strengths-limits.png){width=94%}

![One code base, many platforms.](images/cross-platform.png){width=94%}

::: {.callout-warning title="Watch out!"}
The engine export is only the start of a port.
:::

::: {.callout-note title="Do it · Strength and limit"}
Write one strength and one limit of each kind of platform for *Pocket
Quest*.
:::

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 4 · Strengths and limits"}
Choose the platform.

::: {.match extra="a keyboard|a router"}
biggest reach, but battery and heat
:   mobile

strong hardware, but many configurations
:   gaming PC

fixed hardware, but certification
:   console

no download, but needs a fast network
:   cloud gaming
:::
:::

Six notes: the **same GPU** for every player, **old laptops to strong
desktops**, **touch and battery**, a **TV stick** with a video stream,
**PC and console players together**, and **adapting** the mobile version
for the PC.

{{< sim file="sims/platform-match.html" poster="sims/platform-match.png" title="Platform Match: which platform is it?" kind="game" height="460" >}}

::: {.callout-tip title="Try it 5 · The notes"}
Choose the word that fits.

::: {.match extra="a cable|a backup"}

:   porting

## Summary {.summary}

- A gaming platform is hardware, software, a store and its rules.
- Consoles: fixed hardware, dev kits and certification.
- PCs: varied hardware, settings and system requirements.
- Mobile: biggest reach, touch, battery and heat; mostly free-to-play.
- Cloud gaming: the server runs the game; the network decides the
  experience.
- Cross-platform games still need porting; cross-play and cross-save
  connect the players.
